description: Trigger: peering/feed_negotiation.rs update_peer_groups stores group names received from a peer verbatim without any format validation. A peer can send group names containing SQL metacharacters, NULL bytes, excessively long strings, or path traversal components. Bad behavior: the peer_groups.group_name column receives attacker-controlled data. While sqlx parameterized queries prevent SQL injection, the unvalidated strings propagate into group-filter comparisons, log messages, and admin API responses, widening the attack surface unnecessarily.
title: attacker-controlled peer can inject arbitrary group names into peer_groups table
